name: docker-manager
description: Docker and Docker Compose over the docker CLI: containers (run, exec, logs, inspect with env redaction, cp, stats, health), images (build, pull, push, tag, save/load, registry login), compose projects targeted by directory/files/name/profiles, networks, volumes, system info/events/contexts, and prune with an exact dry-run preview. Timeouts and output caps on every command.

envVars.name: DOCKER_HOST
envVars.description: Daemon endpoint (e.g. ssh://user@host, tcp://host:2376). Passed through to the docker CLI; unset uses the current context.

envVars.name: DOCKER_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Docker context to use by default. Passed through to the docker CLI; tools also take a per-call 'context'.

envVars.name: DOCKER_CLI
envVars.description: CLI binary to invoke (default: docker). 'podman' works for most tools.

envVars.name: DOCKER_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
envVars.description: Host directories (path-delimiter separated) that cp, build context, compose dir/files, env files and bind mounts must stay inside. Default: the server's working directory.

envVars.name: DOCKER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Timeout for short commands (list, inspect, start, stop, exec) in ms.

envVars.name: DOCKER_MCP_LONG_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Timeout for long commands (build, pull, push, compose up/build/pull, run) in ms.

envVars.name: DOCKER_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Per-stream output cap for a single command; larger output is cut and marked truncated.
